About Me

I've managed roadmaps, backlogs, budgets, automations, implementations,
and the occasional existential crisis. Usually before lunch. 😂

I'm Sharlene Javier, a bilingual Digital Transformation Program Manager with over a decade of experience turning high-stakes, high-complexity technology programs into measurable outcomes.

I've launched the Dominican Republic's first 4G LTE network, built the digital payment infrastructure that brought mobile banking to the unbanked, designed the first-ever audit framework for a state-mandated Medicaid program in New York City, and outsourced core banking infrastructure for a savings association with zero downtime. I make complex projects into a possibility.

My work spans healthcare, fintech, SaaS, ERP, telecom, banking, government, and real estate across the US, Dominican Republic, and Latin America. Whether I'm leading a 25-person cross-functional Agile team, translating 300+ pages of NYSDOH regulations into operational SOPs, or deploying voice AI bots for a digital agency, I bring the same thing: clarity, structure, and outcomes.

Today, besides working as a Program Manager, I also work as a Digital Transformation Freelancer & AI Automation Specialist designing voice AI bots, marketing automation pipelines, and responsive websites, integrating OpenAI, Power Automate, and Zapier into real client workflows. Fluent in English and Spanish, working across the US and Latin America.

And when I'm not in the weeds of a program? I write on Substack about the messy intersection of leadership, systems thinking, and execution, the things that come out of every program that nobody ever writes down.

CSM Scrum Alliance CSPO Scrum Alliance ITIL Foundation HIPAA Certified AI Automation & RPA MS in Project Management

What Companies Hire Me For

They have a transformation in motion a new platform, a new process, a regulatory mandate and they need someone who can take it from kickoff to go-live without losing the thread.

What I Walk In and Fix

Undefined processes. Teams that don't talk. Stakeholders who don't trust the timeline. I establish structure, velocity, and visibility fast.

What Makes My Work Different

I build things that last. Every SOP, dashboard, and training curriculum I design is built to run without me defensible, documented, and ready for audit.
